text:
maria: quick heads-up — I ran a focused KV-cache precision sweep today to see how FP8 vs INT8 (and a lightweight GPTQ-like scheme) affect latency + memory + QA accuracy on the new 13B model. sharing observations and raw numbers, looking for 👀 on weird regressions

cheng: nice, status? what workload / seq len?

maria: benchmark workload: chat-like gen, avg seq=1024, prompt prefix heavy (so KV hit-rate high). 2k requests w/ realistic concurrency (clients=8). baseline is full fp16 weights, fp16 KV.

aj: how did you quantize KV specifically — per-tensor or per-channel? any clipping?

maria: per-tensor for INT8 run; per-channel symmetric for FP8 run. also a middle ground (we called it "hybrid-gptq") where we do per-channel for last 6 layers only and use a fast dequant path for KV (minimal reconstruction). code flags:

```
--kv_quant="int8_per_tensor"
--kv_quant="fp8_per_channel"  # experiments
--kv_dequant_fast=true
--kv_clip=2.5  # tried 1.0, 2.5, 5.0
```

tyler: did you also change KV cache layout (packed vs interleaved)? that's often a perf win.

maria: kept layout constant (interleaved) to isolate numeric effects.

maria: raw results (p50 latency, tokens/s, memory delta vs fp16 KV, and eval on a 1k-sample QA devset — EM change):

```
CONFIG                           p50(ms)   tokens/s   KV-mem  EM-delta (QA)
fp16-KV baseline                  68        145        0%      0.00%
fp8-per-channel                   64        154       -38%    -0.30%  
int8-per-tensor                   59        168       -47%    -1.10%  
hybrid-gptq (last6 pc)           61        162       -43%    -0.55%
fp8-per-channel clip=1.0         66        149       -38%    -0.05%
int8 clip=5.0                     57        172       -45%    -1.40%
```

cheng: hmm int8 buys the most mem and perf, but EM drops ~1.1-1.4% — that's material on QA. fp8 seems like the best tradeoff for QA. any weird per-layer deltas?

maria: yes — per-layer breakdown showed layers 2..4 (early attention) are fragile to int8 — EM drops localized there. when we kept those early layers fp16 (rest int8) we recovered ~0.6% EM with ~30% mem win.

aj: did you check distribution of scale factors / outliers? int8 clip=5.0 increases perf but worsens accuracy — probably letting big outliers distort quant buckets.

maria: we logged scale histograms, here's a snippet from eval-bot output:

```
EVAL-BOT: top-affected-layers:
- attn_k_layer_3: 0.12% samples > 5.0x base-scale
- attn_v_layer_2: heavy tail, 0.9% samples at > 8x
- ffw_11: near-normal
```

eval-bot: note — QA errors are often span misalignments when KV keys shift slightly; overall perplexity only moved 0.2 but EM more sensitive.

tyler: interesting that fp8 clip=1.0 reduced EM loss. sounds like tighter clipping reduces representational noise. did you try per-channel clipping heuristics by layer?

maria: tried a simple rule: if layer tail mass > 0.5% above 4x, set clip=1.0 for that layer; otherwise 2.5. that recovered another ~0.2% EM vs global 2.5. config is a simple JSON we used:

```
{
  "kv_quant": "fp8",
  "per_layer_clip": {
    "attn_k_layer_2": 1.0,
    "attn_k_layer_3": 1.0,
    "default": 2.5
  }
}
```

aj: can we get same perf on Dedicated GPUs (bigger batch/container) — these numbers are on a 80GB A10-ish box?

maria: runs were on 80GB A10. we expect Dedicated with better kernel tuning to shave ~5% off p50 and keep same mem wins. I did one trial on an H100 dev node and saw p50s ~10% lower but same relative deltas between configs.

cheng: what's next? do we want to ship fp8 kv-per-channel as default for 13B in private deployments, or provide it as an opt-in knob?

tyler: given EM drop ~0.3% that's probably ok for many apps, but enterprise / retrieval-heavy apps might care. recommend opt-in with a per-namespace default and a migration guide that includes per-layer clipping rules and quick test prompts.

maria: filing a short doc and a PR to add the knob + per-layer heuristics to the optimizer. action items:
- aj: add automatic layer-tail detection and suggest clip values in optimizer (ETA 3d)
- cheng: run Dedicated H100 sweep and add kernel timings to dashboard (ETA 2d)
- tyler: draft migration note for customers + opt-in flag names (ETA 4d)

aj: taking aj -> will open draft PR today.

maria: thanks all. posting the raw logs to the bucket: s3://redwood-internal/kv-sweeps/1749123456/ — ping me if you need the run scripts. :rocket:

sre-bot: deploy-notification: perf-dashboard updated with new series (kv_precision_sweep_1749123456).

maria: any objections to me promoting fp8-per-channel to 'recommended' in console presets if eval teams don't call out regressions within 5 days? otherwise i'll leave as opt-in.

cheng: no objections from me. go ahead but mark as "recommended (monitoring)" and add quick rollback in console. :+1:

tyler: agree. let's monitor QA EM and perplexity across customers for a week.

maria: noted. will follow up with a brief report in #eng-ml next week.
